function.name: add_memory
function.description: Store a text memory in SULCUS. Creates a node with embedding and adds it to the active index. Use this to record facts, events, user preferences, or any information that should persist across conversations.

content.description: The text content to store as a memory.

function.name: search_memory
function.description: Hybrid semantic search against stored memories. Combines cosine similarity (vector embeddings, weight 0.6) with full-text search (weight 0.4). Returns the most relevant nodes. Call this before answering questions that may relate to past events or known facts.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10.

function.name: build_context
function.description: Run ignite+tick for the given prompt, then render hot nodes as a structured XML context block partitioned by memory_type (preferences/facts/procedures/recent) with tombstone stubs. Feed this XML directly into your system prompt. This is the recommended single call to enrich context before generation.

prompt.description: Current user prompt used to ignite relevant nodes.

token_budget.description: Approximate token budget for the context block. Default: 2000.

function.name: query_memory
function.description: Vector-only semantic search against local embeddings. Optionally scoped to a named Fold (memory namespace). Use search_memory for better relevance; use this when you need pure vector similarity.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 10.

fold_name.description: Restrict search to this named memory namespace (Fold).

function.name: get_node
function.description: Fetch a specific memory node by its UUID.

node_id.description: UUID of the node to fetch.

function.name: upsert_node
function.description: Create or update a memory node with explicit fields. Use add_memory for simple text storage; use this when you need fine-grained control over heat, utility, or memory type.

function.name: list_hot_nodes
function.description: List the top-N memory nodes ordered by their subjective importance score (current_heat + 0.5 * base_utility). Use active_index for the pre-built cached version; use this for fresh live ranking.

limit.description: Number of nodes to return. Default: 20.

function.name: fetch_payload
function.description: Retrieve the full raw text content of a memory node. Accessing the payload reinforces the node's base_utility and ignites its heat (simulating a memory 'page fault'). Use this when you need the complete original text beyond the pointer_summary.

node_id.description: UUID of the node whose payload to fetch.

function.name: commit_memory
function.description: Atomically create a node, store its raw content payload, and link it to related nodes via Hebbian edges — all in one transaction. Use this for structured memory creation with explicit relationships.

raw_content.description: Full text content to store in the payload.

connected_node_ids.description: UUIDs of existing nodes to link to.

function.name: ignite_and_tick
function.description: Embed the given prompt, ignite the nearest memory nodes (raise their heat), then run a thermodynamics tick (decay + active_index rebuild). Returns the updated active_index. Use build_context for a richer formatted result.

prompt.description: Text to embed and use for nearest-node ignition.

function.name: active_index
function.description: Fetch the pre-built active index: the top-N hottest memory nodes from the shared zero-copy buffer. Includes tombstone stubs for recently evicted nodes. This is the fastest way to get current working memory context.

limit.description: Maximum number of nodes to return. Default: 20.

function.name: forget_memory
function.description: Permanently and irreversibly delete a memory node along with all its edges, embeddings, and payload. Use retract_memory if you want to preserve a tombstone audit trail.

node_id.description: UUID of the node to permanently delete.

purge_cold.description: Also remove the cold_storage archive entry. Default: false.

function.name: retract_memory
function.description: Soft-retract a node: retire all its edges and zero out heat+utility, but keep the tombstone for auditing. Use forget_memory for hard permanent deletion.

node_id.description: UUID of the node to soft-retract.

function.name: update_memory
function.description: Patch an existing memory node's label, pointer_summary, raw_content, and/or memory_type. Re-embeds if content changes. Resets current_heat to 1.0 to reflect the update event.

function.name: pin_node
function.description: Pin a memory node so it is never pruned by the thermodynamics decay engine. Use for critical context that must always remain in working memory (e.g. user identity, project scope, hard constraints).

function.name: unpin_node
function.description: Unpin a previously pinned node, making it eligible for normal thermodynamic decay and pruning.

function.name: summarize
function.description: Generate a short deterministic extractive summary of a text block. Works fully offline with no LLM required. Useful for compressing long content before storing it as a memory.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters in the summary. Default: 500.

function.name: record_fold
function.description: Create or update a Fold — a named memory namespace. Use Folds to separate memories by project, client, conversation, or context.

content.description: Memory content to store in this Fold.

function.name: switch_fold
function.description: Activate a named Fold as the current working set. Rebuilds the active_index to show only nodes from this Fold.

limit.description: Number of nodes to include in rebuilt active_index. Default: 20.

function.name: dispatch_background_task
function.description: Fire-and-forget SULCUS maintenance task. Returns immediately with a task_id; the task executes in a background thread without blocking the agent. Available tasks: 'tick' (decay + rebuild index), 'prune_cold_nodes' (delete below heat threshold), 'sync' (push/pull to server), 'full_maintenance' (tick + prune + sync).

args.description: Optional task arguments: decay (float), prune_threshold (float), active_limit (int), threshold (float).

function.name: retire_edge
function.description: Soft-delete a directed edge between two nodes by setting its valid_to timestamp. Retired edges stop conducting heat during spreading activation.

function.name: metrics
function.description: Return runtime and storage metrics: active_index size, database file size, node/edge counts, memory operation count, thermodynamics tick count.

function.name: export_markdown
function.description: Export memory nodes to a portable Markdown file. Provide fold_name to export a single Fold, or omit to export the entire graph ordered by heat. Vectors are excluded and will be re-embedded on import.

function.name: import_markdown
function.description: Import a SULCUS Markdown file created by export_markdown. Upserts nodes, payloads, and edges. Vectors are not restored and will be re-embedded on next use.

file_path.description: Path to the .md file to import.

function.name: sync_now
function.description: Immediately push local WAL deltas to the configured SULCUS_SERVER_URL and pull remote ops. Requires SULCUS_SERVER_URL to be set. Use dispatch_background_task with task='sync' for non-blocking sync.
